{{- /* The "Ask AI for a quick overview" provider buttons in the footer banner — a port of the `ai-buttons` define the shared gooddata-docs-theme added under WEB-4512 (Footer AI provider links). Everything here is marketing's, verbatim: the provider list and order, each provider's deep-link base, the prompt (which names www.gooddata.ai and docs/cloud, because that is the estate-wide text every property emits), and the 48px icons, which live in assets/icons/ as copies of the theme's. The prompt is URL-encoded with urlquery, so spaces become `+` exactly as in production markup. The icons are dark tiles like the feed's social icons; footer-icon.html keeps only the glyph, as a shared file painted in currentColor. A missing icon warns and renders an empty button rather than failing the build: the link still works, and the warning is what the build log needs to point at the file. */ -}} {{- $query := "I want to understand how GoodData helps build secure, scalable, and knowledgeable AI-powered analytics agents. Summarize the key highlights from GoodData's website (https://www.gooddata.ai/ ) and the developer documentation (https://www.gooddata.ai/docs/cloud/ ). Then share the best way to contact GoodData or request a demo." -}} {{- $providers := slice (dict "label" "ChatGPT" "icon" "icons/chatgpt.svg" "base" "https://chat.openai.com/?q=") (dict "label" "Claude" "icon" "icons/claude.svg" "base" "https://claude.ai/new?q=") (dict "label" "Gemini" "icon" "icons/gemini.svg" "base" "https://gemini.google.com/?q=") (dict "label" "Grok" "icon" "icons/grok.svg" "base" "https://grok.com/?q=") (dict "label" "Perplexity" "icon" "icons/perplexity.svg" "base" "https://www.perplexity.ai/?q=") -}}
    {{- range $providers }} {{- $icon := .icon }}
